exact_statement: For every r,d>=1, the fresh balanced rare-switch chain F_0=x_0, F_t=(1-A_r)F_(t-1)+A_r y_t, p=2^-r, q=1-p has H=[q^2 log2(1/q^2)+2rp(2-p)](1-q^d)/p, I=1+r(1-q^d), B=r[phi(q^2,p^2)+2p-2p^2](1-q^d)/p, phi(u,v)=(u+v)h2(v/(u+v)). The repeated concavity-root log D=sum_(t=1)^(d-1)q^(d-t)Lambda(F_t) is at least p d(d-1)q^(2d); the exact continuation L is zero. For every a>=1 and even m>=2, F=b(y)-2A_a(z)1_(y=0), quadratic bent b, p=2^-a, delta=2^-m has I_W=2ap delta, I_data=m(1/2+2p delta), and L-32p delta/(a ln2)<=B_W/I_W<=L with L=2(1-p)(m+2a-2+1/ln2)/a. On a class closed under disjoint tensor powers, H<=CI+D0 with a fixed finite D0 implies H<=CI with the same multiplicative C.
